preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The length of the string s must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not is_palindrome_possible(s) else any(int(x) in range(1, len(s) + 1) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to form a palindrome, output -1; otherwise, output a valid permutation of indices.
The output must contain exactly n integers, where n is the length of the string s.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) >= 1 and int(x) <= len(s) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output must be valid indices within the range of the string s.
